label: Copy Content
description: Copies whatever the request names as its source into the item this step works on (the one an earlier step created, or else the one this request is about). A request naming no source copies nothing, so copying can be optional.

sourceType.label: Source type
sourceType.description: The type of content a source must be, e.g. "wf/WorkflowVersion". Left blank, a source of any type is copied.

skipProperties.label: Properties not copied
skipProperties.description: Properties of the source that are not copied, such as a label the copy has its own of.

dropTagCategories.label: Tag groups not copied
dropTagCategories.description: Tag groups whose tags on the source are not copied, such as where the source stands in its lifecycle.
